characters.name: Todd Daring
characters.description: The lazy, trouble-making, and selfish Daring sibling. Annoying Younger Sibling: To Riley. Brilliant, but Lazy: He's good with scheming, and put can only do well in school when properly motivated. Catchphrase: "Don't judge me!" and "Suh-weet" Didn't Think This Through: One of Todd's major flaws is that he is very impulsive, as he is willing to make a plan to get out of a situation without realizing the consequences, which is why most of his schemes fall flat:"Truth or Daring" is a major example of this. In that episode, Todd is tired of Riley always being honest, so he gives her truth salt to teach her a lesson that honesty is not always the best policy. He also infects himself with lie spice as a way to make himget excused at schoolandto make a fool out of others. He didn't take into account that the truth salt makes Riley tells the truth to others, including himself and he only finds out about the lie spice's side effects, after accidentally lying to the librarian. Naturally,his plan ends up getting him in major amounts of trouble, including having to endureTraining from Hell.It ultimately results in him getting karmic comeuppance at the end by getting truth salt forced by Agent K.

characters.name: Riley Daring
characters.description: The kind, caring, and reliable Daring sibling. All Girls Like Ponies: She loves ponies and unicorns, and she is a fan of an in-universe horse movie calledThe Majestic Horse. Between My Legs: InThe Majestic Horse. Big Eater: She isn't one 99% of the time, but whenany sugary foodsenter her line of sight, they will be gone at record speed no matter how much there is. Feminine Mother, Tomboyish Daughter: Inverted. She's the pony loving Feminine Daughter to Agent K's athletic spy Tomboyish Mother.

characters.name: Dick Daring
characters.description: The siblings' world-famous daredevil adoptive father. Alliterative Name:DickDaring. Big Eater: Can eat huge quantities of food. The episodeSee Dick Runsees him eat 37 pounds of ice cream, just to beat the record at the ice cream shop by one pound. The record was already his to begin with and he only just set it yesterday. Bumbling Dad: He's certainly not the sharpest tool in the shed in comparison to the rest of his family. Despite this, he's still a loving husband and is always there for his kids.A Daring Romanceshows that despite his flaws, Dick is willing to make a conscious effort to be better. Butt-Monkey: Dick is usually the biggest source of physical comedy on the show, and can walk away from almost anything completely unfazed.

characters.name: Agent K Daring
characters.description: The siblings' adoptive mother who is of British descent and is a super spy. Action Mom: She's a spy with a mastery of martial arts, but also a caring and devoted mother. Cloudcuckoolander: Let's just say that she's very eccentric. Conspiracy Theorist: She is rather paranoid. Embarrassing Middle Name: Mildred.

characters.name: C.A.R.
characters.description: The high-tech family car with a British accent. He can do just about anything, but is not always willing to do something for the family, and especially not for Dick. Automated Automobiles: Although he can be driven, he more often than not drives himself. Cool Car: When he's not acting like a snob. Deadpan Snarker: Mostly towards Dick. Expy: To KARR from Knight Rider.

characters.name: Prince Cinnamon Boots
characters.description: The Daring Family's pet mule. The Alleged Steed: He is a mule given to Riley by her father when she asked for a show horse. Butt-Monkey: In terms of being remembered by the family. The Dog Bites Back: After being forgotten so many times by the Daring family, he decides to take over the house and lock them out until they apologize for their behavior. Something We Forgot: ARunning Gagthroughout the show is the cast forgetting about his existance and leaving him left out on either their adventures or his own adventures.

characters.name: Conrad Fleem
characters.description: The mysterious owner of the Fleemco company. He processes Todd and Riley's requests whenever they call him. Borrowed Catchphrase:In theGrand Finale, he exclaims Todd'sCatchphrase"Don't judge me!" twice. The first time he said it made Todd realize he's their uncle. The Faceless: We only see him from behinduntil the series finale. Luke, I Am Your Father:Just replace father with uncle and you can fill in the rest... Shared Family Quirks:He says Todd'sCatchphrase"Don't judge me!" twice and has the same craving for sugar as Riley. This clued in to Todd that Conrad's their uncle.

characters.name: Tasumi
characters.description: Riley's Japanese best friend. She always wears a pink armor and claims her family is part of a crime-fighting team. She also has a list of people she hates. In "Tasumi Unmasked", it's revealed that Tasumi is in fact a Japanese pop star. She moved to Pleasant Hills in order to escape the constant adoration of her fans and live a peaceful life. In order to make sure that nobody recognized her, she wore a costume from a popular TV show and used details from that show in order to get a new history. 24-Hour Armor: Never took off her armor until "Tasumi Unmasked" by Riley's hand. Justified so that she could disguise herself as either a Sentai/Power Ranger like girl or at least a girl delusional enough to think she was one to avoid her hordes of Pop Idol fans. Beautiful All Along: Her blue hair and attitude hints to anAsian and Nerdylook, but Riley after unmasking her regards her as cute. Catchphrase: "You're back on my list!" and "That's wacky time!"

characters.name: Jacobo Jacobo
characters.description: Todd's best friend who is of Mexican descent. Last-Minute Hookup: He hooks up withTasumiin "Irreplaceable", catching Riley and Todd by surprise. Precocious Crush: He has one on Agent K. Repetitive Name: His given and surnames are exactly the same. Spell My Name With An S: His name is constantly being misspelled as "Hakobo", even by the close-captions, as it's easy for non Spanish speakers to miss the fact that J in Spanish is pronounced like H is in English.

characters.name: Abbey Willson
characters.description: Riley's other best friend. Rich Bitch: She tends to have these moments in the prescience of other rich characters to fit in with them at the expense of her average friends.Her sisteris a more straightforward example. Her sisteris a more straightforward example. Token Evil Teammate: Downplayed, but she's the only one of Riley's friends who would side withAlpha BitchSierra and the otherRich Bitchcharacters just for the sake of her class status. Otherwise she's still part of Riley's friend group. With Friends Like These...: Agrees or laughs withSierra's insults from time to time. She often gets glares from both Riley and Tasumi because of this, prompting her to sheepishly apologize just as often.

characters.name: Shelton Klutzberry
characters.description: TheStereotypical Nerdat school. Beautiful All Along: When he loses hisNerd Glasses. Given that his mother is a case ofUgly Guy, Hot Wife, he clearly inherited his mother's good looks. Blind Without Them: When he loses his glasses and tries to run away, he can't help but collide everywhere. Butt-Monkey: The subject of most of the slapstick and insults whenever he's around. Dumber Than They Look: Shelton looks and sounds like a stereotypical nerd with hisscrawny physique, poor posture and hugeNerd Glasses. However, as the series goes on it becomes clear that Shelton is actually an incredibly dim and gullible individual, and never shows any signs of being prolific at academia or any sort of intelligence. In "Truth or Daring" Todd manages to trick him into agreeing to challenging a professional wrestler to a fight (keep in mind Shelton isn't evenstrong enough to crush an egg). After he's been viciously defeated, Todd tries to trick him into a rematch by lying the wrestler has a fear of Crabs and raspberries. Shelton not only agrees but hopelessly misinterprets Todd's advice.

characters.name: Buzz Winters
characters.description: A wannabe bully and Todd's arch nemesis. Catchphrase: "Buzz fury!", "Good one, Buzz", and calling Todd and Riley "losers". Compensating for Something: Wields a big mallet to compensate for having tiny feet. Go-Karting with Bowser: A few episodes of Season 1 had him participating in Todd and Riley's activities. Green and Mean: He wears a green t-shirt and is very mean to others.

characters.name: Johnny Hitswell
characters.description: The subject of Riley's affection. He enjoys basketball and baseball. In season two he starts dating Riley, but breaks up with her for being to controlling after she followed him all the way to New York with Abby and Tasumi. Big Man on Campus: The most popular guy in school who Riley has a crush on. Punny Name: JohnnyHits well. Geddit? Satellite Love Interest: Ends up getting subverted. His main development is how he interacts with Riley, but breaks up with her upon realizing that she's too controlling and he wants a life of his own.

characters.name: SierraMcCool
characters.description: The popular girl at school, and Riley's arch nemesis. Alpha Bitch: The most popular girl in school, fairly well off, and a total jerk. Awesome McCoolname: An extreme example of this. Beauty Is Bad: She is a total heartthrob and a cutie, but she's a snootyAlpha Bitch. Closet Geek: A big fan ofStar Journeys, but she keeps that a secret since her fellow cheerleaders wouldn't think it's cool.

characters.name: Donny Rottweiller
characters.description: A professional bully who is Buzz's mentor and Todd's other nemesis. The Bully: More consistently than Buzz, given that the latter can at least be aToken Evil Teammate. Eviler than Thou: Buzz is eager to learn from him because he's a lot crueler than he'll ever be. Donny doesn't even consider Todd a rough friend from time to time like Buzz. Evil Mentor: To Buzz in bullying, who is giddy about being in the presence of a master.

characters.name: Ace Palmero
characters.description: Pleasant Hills' local news reporter. Delusions of Local Grandeur: He is aSmarmy Hostwho thinks too big of himself, treating everyone else in a condescending way.

characters.name: Dr. Scorpius
characters.description: Punch-Clock Villain: Contrary to what Agent K thinks, he can actually go on vacation without having a hidden evil agenda. Unholy Matrimony: Subverted. His wife knows he's a villain, and she seems to be okay with it, but she takes no personal interest in his work.
